item.title: USS Abraham Lincoln to dock in Thailand next week after record Middle East deployment – US politics live
item.summary: Ship has not made a port call for more than 200 days and there have been reports of low morale and poor mental health amid food and water shortages Sign up for the US Breaking News email Despite reports over poor conditions on board the US Navy aircraft ⁠carrier the USS Abraham Lincoln, which will dock in ⁠ Thailand next ⁠week following a period of more than 200 consecutive days of deployment, Donald Trump claimed the ship was “beautifully maintained”. Earlier this month, the president berated Kristen Holmes, a CNN reporter, insisting that she “be quiet” and describing the reporting of poor conditions on board as fake news. Continue reading...
